The dome became the most valuable seat in entertainment

The screen grew a ceiling, and the money followed. Sphere and Cosm turned the wraparound dome into the format everyone is racing to build.

01 Field notes

Sphere became the top grossing venue on earth

Billboard and Pollstar ranked the Las Vegas Sphere the top grossing venue in the world for 2025. The Wizard of Oz at Sphere has sold more than 2 million tickets and 260 million dollars since its 2025 debut. One room, wall to wall image, and a line out the door.

02
In the lab

The dome is going global and getting company

Sphere is advancing a 1.7 billion dollar venue on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi and a smaller one at National Harbor in Maryland. Meanwhile Sony is investing 100 million dollars in Cosm, which opens a fourth dome in Detroit this September and a fifth in Cleveland after that.
